data.headline: SWE @ Medtronic | Robust Roboticist | Unapologetic Extrovert
data.about:
When I was 8, I told this other kid that I wanted to be an inventor when I grew up. I remember him laughing and telling me that that’s not a thing. I started bawling, and I may have tried to head-butt him (he was taller and stronger, so all’s well). Fast forward to now, with two engineering degrees and active contributions towards two surgical robotic systems, I can safely say I’ve earned somewhat of a license to invent!

With a burning desire to solve practical, real life problems, my goal is to translate my passion into reality. From making a path planning mobile robot zoom around looking for landmarks, to teleoperating a surgical robot via hand tracking, engineering, or "inventing," has become my second nature. 

I love engineering, I love writing, I love people, and I love the Arctic Monkeys, so if any of those spark your interest, I look forward to getting a message from you!

projects.title: Tele-operation Control of a High Dexterity Robot for Vitreoretinal Surgery
projects.subtitle: Jan 2022 - Dec 2022

description.text:
Implemented teleoperative control of a 7 D.O.F hybrid vitrioretinal surgical robot using a Phantom Omni, based on published simulation results.

Accomplished segmented teleoperation of system by teleoperating 5 D.O.F Steady Hand Eye Robot (SHER) with a virtual RCM constraint, and subsequent teleoperation of calibrated 2 D.O.F mini continuum robot, allowing for increased manipulability of tool intraoperatively.

projects.title: Mixed Reality Based Teleoperation of Surgical Robotics
projects.subtitle: Jan 2022 - Nov 2022

description.text: Investigated the potential enhancement of robotic surgery untethered handtracking in augmented reality sphere. Ran a comprehensive user study to validate proposed control mechanism and user interface, designed for Microsoft's Hololens II and interfacing with the DaVinci Research Kit. Research presented (and published) at ISMR 2023

projects.title: Investigation and Simulation of Vestibular Prosthetics
projects.subtitle: Feb 2022 - May 2022

description.text: Collaborated on developing a realistic simulation of a vestibular implant, targetting process pipeline from collection of raw user data to appropriate electrode output. Applied research-backed filtering and data processing techniques to produce realistic charged-balanced biphasic pulse trains via a state machine model, to be delivered to user's semicircular canal

Designed and prototyped an adaptable 2 DOF impedance-style exoskeleton for post-injury rehabilitation of wrist. Our team implemented position and velocity scaling control, utilizing integrated Arduino assembly to actively provide adaptable force in the target direction for user specific rehabilitation program. Established integration plan for incorporating the exoskeleton in actual rehabilitative programs.

projects.title: Investigating Mechanical Properties of Single Crystalline Nanoporous Copper Structures
projects.subtitle: May 2017 - Nov 2019

description.text: Investigated the mechanical properties of single crystalline nanoporous copper structures, via multi-million atomic simulations. Research focused on failure and deformation mechanisms in structure under uniaxial stress, via quantitative and qualitative evaluation of topology and morphology.

Project commissioned for archeological dig around Fort Amsterdam in Ghana. We designed and built a tethered topographic map producing robot, with integrated RP-LiDAR, Raspberry PI, and self-localization via C++ in UNIX, using Lightweight Communication and Marshalling architecture, to produce a viable topographic map with foliage extraction, real time localization and data correction, and live operational verification.

projects.title: Kinetic Energy Redistribution in High Energy Impact
projects.subtitle: Aug 2018 - Dec 2018

description.text: This semester long project revolved around designing and prototyping a protective physical layer for static bodies which would serve to redistribute kinetic energy in a high energy impact via wave propagation, in a bid to protect said static body. This project, after prototyping, is re-entering its mathematical modelling and simulation phase to allow for improvements.

projects.title: Optimal Trajectory Control of Rigid Multi-Body system
projects.subtitle: May 2018 - Aug 2018

description.text: This project involved studying and selecting the most appropriate MATLAB solver to implement optimal trajectory control on a rigid, 3 link robotic arm, in addition to mathematically discretizing and representing the system. Achieved simulated optimization of the input energy for any movement of the multi-body system via direct multiple shooting method in MATLAB and using SUNDIALS suite to discretize state space. This project further established the framework for further work on a complex flexible system

Programmed mobile robotic system to map environment and avoid dynamic obstacles, via sensory input from 2D laser scanners, RGBD cameras, and wheel encoders in a ROS environment.  Employed EKF localization algorithm, mapping using an Occupancy Grid Mapping algorithm and path planning using a A* Search algorithm to traverse pre-determined map via most optimal route.
Associated with University of Rochester

Collaborated with three other engineering students to code and build an autonomous light tracking car, using Arduino. Implemented advanced control theory and vibrations theory to minimize the swing magnitude of an attached pendulum.

projects.title: Social Media, Fake News and Data Privacy: A Journalism Case Study on Social Media in East Africa

description.text: This study aimed to investigate the rapid rate of penetration of social media in East Africa, and the subsequent effect on the production and consumption of journalism. We employed a variety of qualitative and quantitative methods to collect and report our findings, such as a self-made survey, and extensive literature and media review
